# NeuromorphicRL_Locomotion

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A reinforcement learning framework implemented on neuromorphic hardware (e.g., spiking neural networks) to control quadruped locomotion over uneven terrain. Demonstrates energy-efficient, real-time adaptive control for legged robots, a key target for in-network neuromorphic edge processing.
